items.title: Christmas Eve at the Sacred Heart Cathedral
items.times: Carols from about 10pm, then the midnight service; check the parish notices nearer the day
items.why: Delhi's Catholic cathedral keeps Christmas Eve in the open: carols in the hour before, then the midnight service on the school ground next door, lit up and packed. Arrive early, dress warm, and leave the car at home.
